smart_cane.title: Smart Stick for the Blind (3D Simulation)
smart_cane.subtitle: Interactive Three.js physics & dual-sensor ultrasonic travel aid
smart_cane.context_desc: This simulation models the SmartCane™ device developed by IIT Delhi (in partnership with Saksham Trust and Phoenix Medical Systems). While traditional white canes only detect obstacles by physical touch on the ground, dual ultrasonic electronic travel aids detect waist/knee-level obstacles and ground drop-offs/potholes 1.5–2 meters in advance via acoustic beeps and haptic vibrations.

sim_hub.title: Interactive Disability Simulators
sim_hub.subtitle: These interactive experiences use pure CSS filters, Web Audio API synthesis, and SVG matrix transforms to approximate different perceptual and motor experiences.
sim_hub.sim_vision_desc: Simulate cataracts haze, glaucoma peripheral tunnel vision, macular degeneration central scotoma, and color blindness.
sim_hub.sim_hearing_desc: Experience high-frequency auditory attenuation via Web Audio API and simulated tinnitus ringing frequencies.
sim_hub.sim_dyslexia_desc: Watch text letters dynamically rotate, jitter, and swap positions, demonstrating cognitive reading fatigue and reading rulers.
sim_hub.sim_motor_desc: Test fine-motor targeting with a simulated trembling mouse cursor and compare small versus accessible target sizes.
sim_hub.sim_adhd_title: ADHD Focus Mode vs Distraction Challenge
sim_hub.sim_adhd_desc: Compare reading comprehension in a chaotic environment with simulated popups versus a stripped-down Focus Mode reader.
sim_hub.sim_sensory_desc: An educational simulation illustrating auditory and visual sensory sensitivities, with instant emergency stop control.
sim_hub.sim_smartcane_desc: Virtual 3D simulation of dual ultrasonic obstacle detection modeled on the IIT Delhi SmartCane travel aid.
sim_hub.sim_braille_desc: Embossed 6-dot cell interactive matrix, Perkins Brailler keyboard, text-to-Braille translator, and virtual fingertip reading.
sim_hub.sim_isl_desc: ISLRTC-aligned conversational signs dictionary, A-Z fingerspelling explorer, and interactive live word-to-sign animator.
sim_hub.sim_switch_desc: Experience switch access with timed auto-scanning and step-scanning through on-screen keyboards and symbols.
sim_hub.sim_aac_desc: Construct messages using high-contrast pictogram symbols with multilingual speech synthesis and dysfluency filters.
sim_hub.sim_mental_health_desc: Multi-sensory de-escalation exercise with Web Audio soundscapes, 4-4-4-4 box breathing pacer, and emergency card generator.

rights_page.title: Rights & Government Schemes Guide
rights_page.subtitle: Comprehensive legal protections, Unique Disability ID (UDID) application steps, and welfare entitlements under India's Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016.
rights_page.pillars_title: Core Provisions of the RPwD Act, 2016
rights_page.p1_desc: Increased legally recognized conditions from 7 to 21, including Specific Learning Disabilities (Dyslexia), Autism Spectrum Disorder, Cerebral Palsy, Multiple Sclerosis, Acid Attack Survivors, and Parkinson's Disease.
rights_page.p2_desc: Mandates a minimum of 4% reservation in government establishments for persons with benchmark disabilities (≥40% disability), and a minimum of 5% reservation in government higher educational institutions.
rights_page.p3_desc: Mandates barrier-free access in all public buildings, public transport systems, and consumer ICT services. Requires all Indian Government Websites to adhere strictly to GIGW (aligned with WCAG 2.1 Level AA).
rights_page.p4_desc: Enacts strict punitive measures (fines and imprisonment up to 5 years) for acts of violence, insults to dignity, discrimination, or exploitation against persons with disabilities.
rights_page.udid_title: How to Apply for a UDID (Unique Disability ID) Card
rights_page.udid_desc: The UDID card is a single, tamper-proof national identity card issued by DEPwD, Government of India, eliminating the need to carry multiple physical medical certificates.
rights_page.udid_s1_desc: Visit swavlambancard.gov.in and click 'Apply for Disability Certificate & UDID Card'.
rights_page.udid_s2_desc: Upload Aadhaar card, proof of address, passport photo, and any prior clinical diagnosis papers.
rights_page.udid_s3_desc: Visit your designated District Civil Hospital or Medical Board for assessment on the scheduled date.
rights_page.udid_s4_desc: Track your application status online; download your digital e-UDID card and receive the plastic card by post.
rights_page.inst_islrtc_name: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre
rights_page.inst_islrtc_desc: Standardizes Indian Sign Language dictionary and develops bilingual educational resources.
rights_page.inst_nivh_name: National Institute for the Visually Handicapped
rights_page.inst_nivh_desc: Braille printing presses, vocational skill training, and smart cane distribution.
rights_page.inst_ayj_name: Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities
rights_page.inst_ayj_desc: Audiological evaluations, speech therapy, and pediatric cochlear implant guidance.
rights_page.inst_nild_desc: Orthotic and prosthetic manufacturing, rehabilitation surgery, and wheelchair ergonomics.
rights_page.inst_niepid_name: National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Intellectual Disabilities
rights_page.inst_niepid_desc: Cognitive behavioral therapies, inclusive curriculum planning, and parent counseling.
rights_page.inst_alimco_name: Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India
rights_page.inst_alimco_desc: Manufacturer and supplier of motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, and smart assistive aids under ADIP.

about_page.title: About Sahay (सहाय)
about_page.subtitle: An open-access educational and assistive technology platform designed to make disability awareness, lived-experience simulations, and modern accommodations accessible to everyone.
about_page.mission_desc: Disability is often viewed through medicalized or sympathetic lenses. Sahay is built on the Social Model of Disability: that people are disabled by barriers in environmental and digital design, not by their impairments. By providing real-time empathy simulators, working browser-powered assistive tools, and comprehensive legal guides, we aim to equip students, teachers, and developers to build universally inclusive products.
about_page.commitments_badge: Built to WCAG 2.2 Level AA Standards
about_page.c1_desc: Every element adheres to strict contrast ratios across Light, Dark, High Contrast, and Yellow-on-Black modes.
about_page.c2_desc: All links, buttons, drawers, and modal dialogs are fully navigable using Tab, Shift+Tab, Arrow Keys, and Escape.
about_page.c3_desc: All interactive elements maintain a minimum target size of 44x44 CSS pixels to accommodate motor tremors and touch screens.
about_page.c4_desc: A global toggle transforms complex clinical terminology into plain-language summaries with visual icons.
about_page.citations_desc: All factual statements, epidemiology numbers, and legal citations in Sahay are derived from verified official bodies:
